title: Specification of the IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) Protocol for the Exchange of Flow Information
summary: This document specifies the IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) protocol, which transmits traffic flow information over the network. It describes how Data and Template Records are carried over several transport protocols from an Exporting Process to a Collecting Process. It is an Internet Standard.

eli5.summary: Routers keep track of who talked to whom, and IPFIX is the standard way to send that record to a collector.

questions: how to export network flow data
